thread_text:
mina: quick FYI. SDK 4.1.0-canary introduced a subtle header rename that causes eu-west fallback routing to kick to slower fallback nodes for a subset of gen requests. planning a scoped runtime pin in eu-west for the affected model-cohort during the 22:30 UTC change window so we don't impact Dedicated customers.

chris: can you paste the canary snippet? :mag:

mina: log excerpt:
```
2026-06-30T21:45:12Z WARN router: unexpected header 'X-Client-Model-Alt', falling back to default route
request_id: r-7f4a2c
region: eu-west-1
sdk: 4.1.0-canary
runtime: 3.10.2
route: /v1/gen
```

pm-olga: impact note: 3 Dedicated tenants in eu-west send high-throughput gen traffic; fallback doubles latency and increases cost. ops suggests a scoped runtime pin for model-group:gen-core in eu-west and a temporary cross-region reroute for only the most impacted tenant if needed.

mina: proposed plan: 1) Scoped runtime pin: `deploybot pin add --id cr-5001 --runtime runtime:3.10.0-stable --scope "region:eu-west,model-group:gen-core" --duration 3h --meta "reason:SDK4.1-header-compat"` at 22:30 UTC. 2) If a single tenant still sees >2x p95 after pin, failover their traffic to us-west via routing override: `deploybot route override --tenant t-88 --target region:us-west --reason "latency-mitigation"`. Monitor: route-fallback-count, p95 latency, error-rate. Rollback criteria: if node-level CPU or GC pressure rises >25% after pin, revert pin.

devops-bot: scheduled action cr-5001 for 2026-06-30T22:30:00Z by mina.

deploybot: executed cr-5001 at 2026-06-30T22:30:05Z  runtime pinned runtime:3.10.0-stable to scope:region:eu-west,model-group:gen-core (cr-5001).

srebot: alert rule created: metric=route-fallback-count(region=eu-west) > 0.2% over 5m -> page @oncall-eng-sre. escalation: 10m -> pm-olga.

chris: initial telemetry shows fallback-count dropped ~90% after pin. p95 for the cohort back to baseline. holding 30m watch.

mina: tenant t-88 still at ~1.8x p95 after pin. planning targeted reroute for that tenant at T+40m if no improvement. anyone object?

pm-olga: approve targeted reroute if telemetry doesn't improve in 15m. coordinate with customer success before executing.

mina: executing targeted reroute for t-88: `deploybot route override --tenant t-88 --target region:us-west --ttl 2h --meta "mitigation:eu-fallback-latency"`

deploybot: executed route override ro-8801 at 2026-06-30T23:10:02Z  tenant t-88 routed to region:us-west (ro-8801).

srebot: note: after reroute, t-88 p95 returned to baseline. tracking for 30m.

chris: small side-effect: two nodes in eu-west showing elevated GC after pin; CPU up ~18% and GC p99 spiked. recommending we watch for 20m and be ready to rollback pin if it crosses threshold.

mina: agreed. rollback plan: `deploybot pin remove --id cr-5001` or `deploybot rollback --id cr-5001 --target runtime:3.10.2 --force` (prefer remove when SDK patch available). If we hit node pressure >25% or any pager, remove pin immediately and keep tenant reroute if beneficial.

devops-bot: alert rule: eu-west-node-gc > 25% over 5m -> page @oncall-eng-sre now.

srebot: after 12m GC pressure softened to normal range, no pager. we'll keep 30m window.

mina: update: after full 3h window, all metrics stable and SDK team rolled a patch to restore header compatibility in 4.1.1-canary. plan to lift pin at 01:30 UTC and remove route override for t-88.

deploybot: executed pin removal cr-5001-removed at 2026-07-01T01:30:05Z  pin removed.

deploybot: executed route override removal ro-8801-removed at 2026-07-01T01:31:10Z  tenant t-88 routing restored to normal.

srebot: lifecycle logged: cr-5001 created->active->removed; ro-8801 created->active->removed. no pagers triggered.

pm-olga: relnote added: "Scoped runtime pin in eu-west and tenant-level reroute to mitigate SDK 4.1.0 header compatibility regression affecting gen traffic; patched in SDK 4.1.1."

mina: customer-success notified impacted tenants with mitigation details and timeline. closing thread unless folks want to add anything. :white_check_mark:
